All Emotions, One Soul

Joy, sorrow, anger and hope are not opposites. They are fragments of the same mask — the human face, complete only when it is allowed to feel everything.

About the Show

Bhawa 2026

BHAWA 2026 is the official talent show organised by the 10th Batch of the Faculty of Technology, University of Ruhuna.

A celebration of creativity, expression, passion and human emotion.

Where It Happens

The Stage

The Mask The central face of BHAWA — gold on one side, shadow on the other. Every soul wears both.
Peacock A symbol of grace and transformation, watching over the stage from both wings.
Tribal Art Ancient patterns radiate from the mask like a crown — emotion rendered as ornament.
Emotion Wall Faces of laughter and anguish rise behind the mask — the full range of what it means to feel.
